coordinate_units: Original-image native pixels; xyxy half-open integer envelopes.
matching_method: Exact Fraction-valued Hungarian maximum-total-IoU one-to-one assignment with unmatched dummy entries. Zero-overlap pairs are never reported as matches. IDs sorted for deterministic tie handling.
descriptive_convention: IoU >= 0.5 AND every absolute boundary difference <= 8 native pixels, tested exactly. Exploratory display-coordinate convention; not calibrated segmentation accuracy.
limitations: Geometric envelope matching only; topology and ink ownership can differ even when envelopes match.
Observer-estimated coordinate uncertainty is uncalibrated and is reported without converting it into an accuracy claim.
Counts describe reported annotation records and matching denominators, never physical body counts.
No class, letter, key, date, mask-resolution, or source-truth upgrade follows from this comparison.
